Netberg announced the new Aurora 721 100G and Aurora 421 10G switches, which feature programmable pipelines powered by Broadcom StrataXGS® Trident3 Ethernet switch chips. The Aurora 421 is a multirole 10G switch with 48x 10G SFP+ and 6x 100G QSFP28 ports. Its heart is Broadcom® StrataXGS® Trident3-X5 BCM56771 silicon, which brings bandwidth, network intelligence, and programmability to the 10G world. The Aurora 721 is a 100GbE universal switch with 32x 100G QSFP28 ports and Broadcom® StrataXGS® Trident3-X7 BCM56870 silicon. It offers novel overlays, instrumentation and telemetry, and pipeline programmability. Both systems are meticulously engineered with high availability in mind. Dual power-sharing redundant PSUs and N+1 cooling fans in a compact 1U form factor meet the demands of modern data centers, CSPs, enterprises, and telecom operators. The Netberg Aurora 721 is a 100GbE switch suited for Top-of-Rack/Spine Datacenter, Enterprise, and CSP network deployments. It has 32 x 100GbE QSFP28 interfaces and supports up to 128 interfaces using DAC break-out cables. The system uses Broadcom Trident3-X7 silicon that introduces data plane programmability. The programmable pipeline allows new features to be added after deployment using in-field upgrades, providing capex investment protection for operators. Support for new overlays and tunneling such as GENEVE, NSH, VXLAN, GPE, MPLS, MPLS over GRE/UDP, GUE, ILA, and PPPoE, new instrumental features bring intelligence to the network and push service capacity to the next level. Performance is backed by a quad-core Intel Atom C3508 processor, up to 32GB DDR4 memory, and 64GB SSD drive for application deployment.
